method.Intelligence: Each split is chance-corrected against its average option count. Invalid or missing decisions count as wrong; split weights are 35% public and 65% sealed.
method.Gap: Public-minus-sealed accuracy gaps match source families with at least ten items in both splits, weighted by n_public*n_sealed/(n_public+n_sealed). Intelligence multiplier is max(0,1-max(0,gap-15)/100). Unavailable matched gaps apply no inferred penalty.
method.Calibration: Ten-bin ECE of predicted maximum option probability and correctness, multiplied by probability coverage. Label-only models have zero coverage and inherited zero Calibration. API forecast vectors are model-reported probabilities, not native token logprobs.
method.Speed: Measured full-call p50 and nearest-rank p95; GPU adjustments are 2*raw+0.15 seconds. API timings include provider transport and uniform transport retries. Timings and their coverage are disclosed.
method.Cost: Actual measured GPU seconds at the selected rental rate, or validated API cost receipts/preregistered tariffs, per 1,000 covered decisions. Missing cost has no invented free value; partial coverage attenuates the cost axis. Startup, downloads and idle rentals are operational spend.
method.Timing comparability: Retained author adapters differ: OpenJev v5 records forward-only timing; Standard One reports serving model time; djev includes model time with loopback overhead. Winnow reports native elapsed model runtime including host work as an explicit GPU-reserved cost proxy. Bonsai adds a monotonic timer around the unchanged native endpoint; that proxy includes vision preprocessing, host work and queue time. Neither is CUDA-event active time. These bases limit fine-grained cross-adapter timing and cost comparisons.
method.Probability comparability: GPU adapters retain their author inference and confidence settings. OpenRouter models elicit JSON probability forecasts; Wity and Autoloops return native choice vectors. Calibration is empirical forecast calibration.
method.Wity price basis: Florian-selected Qwen3.6-35B-A3B market reference: USD0.15/M input and USD1/M output applied to returned usage. The published API tariff USD0.042/M input and free output is shown separately as an alternative; no introductory credits are treated as zero-priced inference.
method.Run policy: One complete fresh 573-item attempt per pinned configuration; three public smoke items discarded. Invalid outputs are wrong; interrupted attempts are not stitched. Whole-attempt infrastructure invalidations require evidence recorded before score inspection.
method.Diagnostics: Computer-use and browser-use are separate static screenshot decision tracks. They do not measure executed actions or completed workflows.
method.Dataset availability: Public means designated for publication. Dataset export remains private pending a finalized redistribution licence; sealed items and item-level outputs are not published.
method.Uncertainty: Scores are finite-sample measurements; nearby rank differences are not presented as statistically resolved.

exposure.Reviewer exposure: All selected items were seen by Anthropic/OpenAI during authoring or blind review. This does not establish training independence. The private exposure ledger and template sharing are disclosed.
exposure.Sealed handling: Gold, rationales and review answers remained on Sandy. Gold-free scoring requests were sent only to approved provider endpoints or owned offline GPU evaluator containers.

release_provenance.Source baseline: Immutable v0.1.4 50-system artifact; scores remain in their own tab and are not comparable across changed pools.
release_provenance.Coverage: Every prior v0.1.4 system is measured or has a clearly marked reference with a terminal failure reason. Historical configuration additions are separately pinned.
release_provenance.Author adapter caveats: Existing noncommercial/access restrictions, text-only checkpoints evaluated with image input, omitted image paths and label-only outputs remain disclosed per row; no new private djev results are added. Bonsai preserves its original weights and calibration, but uses a reconstructed image adapter and runtime because the historical evaluator, prompt, context and image digest were not recovered. Winnow also has a reconstructed image adapter and an unproven historical runtime digest.
release_provenance.Rune infrastructure failure: An earlier Rune dispatch failed to stage gated weights before model load and produced no smoke or full predictions. The contemporaneous failure predates the completed evaluation. Earlier assertions of no prior dispatch intent were corrected. Prior intent SHA256 1b9a798e53b87180cd7e71191e01491c81142987394ed76ac3d2817ac9c1e597; metadata eligibility receipt SHA256 acdcc18d3f4bc7ddad3914454736288ec0992fd3e39f0967b279eddec204072b. The measured outputs, scores, configuration and original native admission are unchanged.
